asst.unavailable.no-endpoint: Not configured. An administrator has to connect an AI service before you can ask questions about your data.
asst.unavailable.bad-endpoint: The address of the AI service is not valid. An administrator has to fix it.
asst.unavailable.disabled: The assistant is switched off by an administrator.
asst.unavailable.no-model: No AI model is chosen. An administrator has to set one.
asst.unconfigured: No columns are marked as personal data for this connection yet. Until an administrator marks them, the assistant only gets column names and row counts.
asst.none: No conversations yet. Start one to ask about your data.
asst.mode.manualHint: Every database call waits for your approval.
asst.mode.autoHint: Reads run without asking. Changes always ask first.
asst.mode.autoOff: Auto mode is off: the administrators have not allowed it.
asst.empty: Ask a question about your data. The assistant writes the statement; you decide whether it runs.
asst.hiddenHint: This value is hidden from the assistant. It stands for a real value that only you can see.
asst.step: Looked up the columns of {tables} in {db}.
asst.approval.live: A statement waits for your approval.
asst.approval.where: On {db}. The statement as it will run on your database:
asst.approval.noDb: The statement as it will run on your database:
asst.approval.metadata: Only column names and the row count will go to the assistant: some columns could not be checked.
asst.approval.write.note: Changes always need your approval, also in auto mode.
asst.result.title: Result
asst.result.truncated: Only the first rows are shown.
asst.result.metadata: Only column names and the row count went to the assistant.
asst.refused.title: Not run
asst.refused.user-only: The assistant cannot run this statement. You can run it yourself in an SQL tab.
asst.refused.inference: Not run: it would use personal data in a way that could reveal values.
asst.refused.unanalysable: Not run: the statement could not be checked against the privacy rules.
asst.refused.token: Not run: a hidden value was used in a way that does not work.
asst.refused.audit: Not run: the action could not be recorded.
asst.refused.limit: A limit of this conversation was reached.
asst.refused.unknown-tool: The assistant asked for something that does not exist.
asst.refused.bad-arguments: The assistant sent a request that was not valid.
asst.denied.expired: The approval ran out; the call was not run.
asst.error.ai: The AI service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
asst.error.rate_limited: Too many messages in a short time. Try again in a moment.
asst.error.step_limit: The assistant stopped: too many steps for one message.
asst.error.token_limit: The assistant stopped: the size limit of one message was reached.
asst.error.busy: The assistant is still working on the previous message.
asst.error.no_pending: This call is not waiting for approval any more.
asst.error.approval_invalid: This approval does not fit the call. Review it again.
asst.api.assistant_busy: The assistant is still working on the previous message.
asst.api.assistant_wrong_target: This conversation belongs to another database connection.
asst.api.assistant_auto_not_allowed: The administrators have not allowed auto mode.
asst.api.assistant_not_waiting: No call is waiting for approval.
asstAdmin.title: AI assistant
asstAdmin.lead: The assistant answers questions about your data by running statements that each user approves. Here you set what it may see and check how it is connected.
asstAdmin.loadFailed: The page could not be loaded.
asstAdmin.endpoint.title: AI service
asstAdmin.endpoint.lead: The address and the key come from the environment of the server and cannot be changed here.
asstAdmin.settings.title: Switches
asstAdmin.settings.lead: Every change needs a second-factor confirmation and is recorded.
asstAdmin.marks.title: Personal data columns
asstAdmin.marks.lead: The values of these columns never go to the AI service as they are: it sees tokens instead. A marking is database.table.column, and a part may be *, for example *.*.email.
asstAdmin.marks.notStored: This installation keeps no store, so markings can only be set in the environment (DBLOOM_PII_COLUMNS).
asstAdmin.suggest.title: Suggestions
asstAdmin.suggest.lead: Column names on the connection you are using that look like personal data. Nothing is marked until you choose.
asstAdmin.suggest.noConnection: Open a database connection first; the suggestions come from its columns.
asstAdmin.suggest.none: No column names look like personal data, or they are marked already.
asstAdmin.suggest.more: More columns match than are shown.
asstAdmin.suggest.reason.name: looks like a person's name
asstAdmin.suggest.reason.finance: looks like a bank or pay detail
asstAdmin.ack.title: No personal data
asstAdmin.ack.lead: If a connection holds no personal data, say so. Without markings and without this statement the assistant only gets column names and row counts for that connection.
asstAdmin.ack.none: No connection is declared free of personal data.
asstAdmin.ack.add: There is no personal data here
asstAdmin.ack.listLabel: Connections declared free of personal data
asstAdmin.error.bad_rule: That is not a marking. Write database.table.column; a part may be *.
asstAdmin.error.bad_target: That is not a connection. Write host:port without spaces.
asstAdmin.error.too_many: There are too many already. Remove some first.
asstAdmin.error.unavailable: This installation keeps no store, so nothing can be saved.
asstAdmin.error.audit_unavailable: The audit log could not be written, so nothing was changed.
